actions.name: add
actions.description: Add something to the pantry or freezer ("we have two bags of frozen peas", "put lasagna in the freezer").

item.description: What it is, in a few words ("frozen peas")

actions.name: remove
actions.description: Take something out of the pantry or freezer when it's used up or eaten ("we used the last of the rice", "took out one lasagna").

count.description: How many were used, if they said

actions.name: whats_there
actions.description: What's in the pantry or freezer, or whether there's something in particular ("what's in the freezer?", "do we have black beans?").

actions.name: dinner_ideas
actions.description: Dinner ideas from what's in the pantry and freezer, from the household's own meals ("what can we make for dinner?").

actions.name: plan_dinner
actions.description: Make one of the ideas tonight's dinner in Meals, when they pick it ("let's do the chili").
